---
title: "Corrected Mixed / Novel Retrieval"
output: html_document
params:
  combined: "data/mixedBreak_clean.csv"
  novel: "data/threeContextsBreak_clean.csv"
  familiar_dir: "outputs/human_state_space_adjudication"
  output: "outputs/mixed_novel_retrieval_corrected"
  profile: "final"
  workers: 6
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE)
```

This document is deliberately separate from the corrected familiar state-space analysis. It calls the tested Python retrieval implementation and then reads its immutable outputs. Mixed, Novel, and NoContextProbe never update familiar states.

```{r input-contract}
required_inputs <- c(
  params$combined,
  params$novel,
  file.path(params$familiar_dir, "familiar_model_selection.json"),
  file.path(params$familiar_dir, "familiar_model_selection.sha256"),
  file.path(params$familiar_dir, "historical_state_space_reproduction.csv"),
  file.path(params$familiar_dir, "human_state_space_parameter_estimates.csv")
)
missing_inputs <- required_inputs[!file.exists(required_inputs)]
if (length(missing_inputs)) {
  stop("Missing immutable retrieval inputs: ", paste(missing_inputs, collapse=", "))
}
```

```{r run, eval=FALSE}
args <- c(
  "scripts/run_mixed_novel_retrieval_corrected.py",
  "--combined", params$combined,
  "--novel", params$novel,
  "--familiar-dir", params$familiar_dir,
  "--output", params$output,
  "--profile", params$profile,
  "--workers", as.character(params$workers)
)
status <- system2("python", args)
stopifnot(status == 0)
```

```{r results}
comparison_path <- file.path(params$output, "first_mixed_model_comparison.csv")
if (file.exists(comparison_path)) {
  knitr::kable(read.csv(comparison_path))
} else {
  stop("Retrieval outputs are absent. Run the Python command in the preceding chunk first.")
}
```

```{r absolute-fit-gate}
config_path <- file.path(params$output, "retrieval_run_config.json")
if (!file.exists(config_path)) stop("Missing retrieval run configuration.")
run_config <- jsonlite::fromJSON(config_path)
if (!isTRUE(run_config$FIT_DIAGNOSTICS_COMPLETE)) {
  stop("Absolute-fit diagnostics incomplete; do not interpret model-selection results.")
}
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(params$output, "posterior_predictive_summary.csv")))
```
